adr.move: Alternate: on one rep raise both dumbbells in front of you, on the next raise them out to the sides.
bd.level: Keep your hips and shoulders parallel to the floor — no twisting.
bd.move: Raise the opposite arm and leg together to the line of your body; return and switch sides.
bd.range: Raise your arm and leg only as high as you can without arching your lower back.
bd.setup: On all fours: hands under your shoulders, knees under your hips, back neutral.
bd.slow: Raise your limbs slowly, without jerking.
bdip.easier: Feet closer to the bench with bent knees make it easier; feet raised make it harder.
bdip.move: Lower yourself by bending your elbows to a light stretch (about a right angle at the elbows); push back up until straight.
bdip.range: Use the full range: down to a light stretch, up to straight arms.
bdip.setup: Put your hands on the edge of a bench behind you, arms straight, legs out in front.
bext.move: Lower your torso by bending at the hips to about a right angle; return to a straight line with your legs.
bext.noArch: Finish at the top in a straight line, without arching your lower back.
bfro.setup: Stand tall, holding the barbell in an overhand grip in front of your thighs, arms hanging down.
bike.foot: Pedal with the front part of your foot.
bike.seat: Set the saddle so that, with the pedal at its lowest point, your leg is nearly straight: knee slightly bent, not locked.
bj.height: Start with a low box and raise it only when your landings are solid.
bj.land: Land softly: knees bent, hips sent back.
bj.move: Dip briefly with an arm swing, jump by extending your hips, knees and ankles; land on the box with both feet.
bj.setup: Stand in front of a stable box, feet hip-width or narrower; pick a height you can land on confidently.
blat.setup: Stand on the band, handles in your hands by your thighs, elbows slightly bent.
bmbt.move: Bend your hips and knees as you lower the ball, then drive up hard and throw it back over your head.
bmbt.setup: Stand facing away from your target, ball in both hands, arms straight in front of you.
bp.blades: Squeeze your shoulder blades together and down, and hold them there throughout.
bp.contact: Head, shoulders and glutes on the bench, feet planted on the floor.
bp.control: Lower the weight slowly — no bouncing off your chest.
bp.elbowsMid: Set your elbows somewhere in the middle — not glued to your sides, not flared out wide.
bp.grip: Grip the bar slightly wider than your shoulders.
bp.mis.arch: Over-arching your lower back or lifting your glutes off the bench to press more.
bp.move: Lower the bar under control to your chest, then press it up until your arms are straight.
bss.move: Bend at the front hip and knee to descend until the back knee nearly touches the floor; drive through the front leg to rise.
bss.setup: With a bench behind you, place the top of your rear foot on it; front foot out in front.
burpee.down: From a squat, put both palms on the floor and hop your feet back so you end up in a push-up position.
burpee.up: Jump your feet back to your hands, then jump up, extending your hips and knees.
bw.squat: Sink into a slight squat and hold it for the whole walk.
calf.edge: Stand on the platform edge on the front of your feet, heels hanging off.
calf.knees: Knees straight or only slightly bent — move only at your ankles.
calf.mis.partial: Short range — not rising fully or lowering fully.
calf.move: Rise as high as you can onto your toes, then drop your heels until the calves are stretched.
calf.pause: Pause briefly at the top and lower slowly.
calf.press: Sit in the leg press with the balls of your feet on the lower edge of the platform, heels off it; legs straight.
calf.pressMove: Push the platform away with your toes as far as you can, then let your heels come back until you feel a calf stretch.
calf.step: Stand with the balls of your feet on a stable step, heels hanging off; hold on to something for balance.
carry.noLean: Keep your torso upright — don’t tip toward the load or away from it; walk tall.
carry.one: Hold one weight in one hand, arm hanging at your side, weight next to your hip.
carry.two: Take one weight in each hand and let your arms hang by your sides, the weights beside your hips.
carry.walk: Walk at a calm, controlled pace for a set distance or time.
cc.ribs: Crunch down, pulling your ribs toward your hips — keep your hips still.
cdr.mis.drop: Your arms sag below shoulder height.
cdr.move: Turn the plate like a steering wheel — one way, then the other; keep your arms at shoulder height throughout.
cdr.setup: Stand tall, hold a plate in both hands and extend your arms in front of you at shoulder height.
cfly.move: With your elbows slightly bent, bring your hands together in front of your chest in a wide arc; return slowly to arms open.
cfly.setup: Set the pulleys at about shoulder height, take the handles and step forward with your arms out to the sides.
cfr.setup: Grab the low-cable handle and stand tall — handle in front of your thighs, arms hanging down.
cgbp.elbows: Keep your elbows close to your body throughout.
cgbp.grip: Grip the bar shoulder-width or slightly narrower — not very narrow.
cgbp.move: Bring the bar down to your chest, elbows tucked near your torso; press it up to straight arms.
chop.close: Keep the weight close to your body, with your head and chest over your hips.
clat.setup: Hold the low-pulley handle with your elbow slightly bent and your torso braced.
cobra.hips: Keep your hips on the floor.
cobra.mis: Forcing your back up too high.
cohp.setup: Stand or sit between the low pulleys; handles at your shoulders, elbows down, wrists over elbows.
cote.move: Straighten your elbows to press the handle overhead; lower it behind your head by bending your elbows.
cote.setup: Hold the cable handle behind your head with your elbows pointing up overhead.
cpress.base: Press your feet into the floor and brace your abs to keep your torso steady.
cpress.setup: Set the pulleys at about chest or shoulder height, stand with your back to the stack, handles by your shoulders.
crear1.move: Sweep your arm out to the side in a wide arc, slightly bent elbow leading, until it reaches shoulder height; lower slowly.
crear1.setup: Stand sideways to the low cable, handle in the far hand; lean your torso forward with a straight back.
crf.move: Spread your arms wide until they form a straight line, then return to the crossed position.
crf.setup: Stand between the two cables and grab the handles crossed: left hand takes the right handle, right hand takes the left.
crunch.lowBack: Your lower back stays on the floor.
crunch.move: Bring your ribs towards your pelvis, lifting your shoulder blades off the floor; lower slowly.
crunch.neck: Keep your neck relaxed — don’t pull on your head with your hands.
crunch.setup: Lie face up, knees bent, hands lightly beside your head.
csr.chest: Rest your chest on the pad and keep it there throughout.
csr.pull: Drive your elbows back along your torso, then straighten your arms fully.
cu.grip: Grip the bar underhand (palms facing you), shoulder-width apart, and hang with straight arms.
cu.pull: Pull up by driving your elbows down to your sides; lower until your arms are fully straight.
curl.bbGrip: Grip the bar underhand, about shoulder-width apart; arms straight.
curl.bbMove: Bend your elbows until your forearms are vertical; lower the bar until your arms are straight.
curl.cableMove: Bend your elbows, bringing the handle towards your shoulders; return until your arms are straight.
curl.cableSetup: Grip the low-pulley handle underhand, arms hanging straight.
curl.control: Lower the weight slowly and under control.
curl.dbMove: Bend your elbow, turning your palm towards your shoulder; lower the dumbbell until your arm is straight.
curl.dbSetup: Stand or sit tall with the dumbbells hanging at your sides, elbows close to your body.
curl.elbows: Hold your elbows still by your sides — only the forearm moves, the upper arm stays put.
curl.ezGrip: Grip the EZ bar underhand, about shoulder-width apart; arms straight.
curl.hammerMove: Bend your elbow, thumb towards your shoulder, until your forearm is vertical; lower until your arm is straight.
curl.hammerSetup: Hold the dumbbells at your sides, palms facing your body.
curl.mis.elbows: Letting your elbows drift forward or away from your body.
curl.noSwing: Keep your torso still: no swinging or leaning back.
cyr.move: Raise your arms up and out to the sides, elbows slightly bent, until they form a Y; lower them slowly.
cyr.setup: Face the machine between the low pulleys and grab the handles crossed; step back until the cables are tight.
db.back: Keep your lower back on the floor — don’t arch it.
db.move: Slowly lower the opposite arm and leg towards the floor without resting them; return and switch sides.
db.setup: Lying face up, point both arms at the ceiling and bend your hips and knees to right angles.
db.slow: Move slowly and keep breathing normally.
dbdl.hips: As you stand up, drive your hips forward to full extension.
dbdl.setup: Stand hip-width apart with the weight by your legs; hinge at the hips with a straight back and grip it.
dbp.move: Press the dumbbells up until your arms are straight; lower them slowly to the sides of your chest.
dbp.setup: Sit with the dumbbells on your thighs, lie back on the bench and bring them to the sides of your chest.
dcgsk.elbows: Keep your elbows in throughout: close to your body on the press, over your shoulders on the extension — never flaring out.
delt1.mis.arch: Leaning back and arching your lower back as you lift.
delt2.haloLean: Your torso tips or arches as the kettlebell goes behind your head.
delt2.handsHigh: Your hands get ahead of your elbows and rise higher than them.
dfly.move: Lower the dumbbells out to the sides in a wide arc until your chest stretches; bring them back over your chest along the same arc.
dfly.setup: Lie on the bench with the dumbbells above your chest, elbows slightly bent.
dfro.setup: Stand tall, holding the dumbbells in front of your thighs, palms facing your body.
diamond.setup: Hands together under the middle of your chest, thumbs and index fingers touching to form a diamond; body straight.
dl.close: Keep the bar close to your legs the whole way.
dl.feet: Feet under the bar, about hip- to shoulder-width apart; the bar close to your shins, over mid-foot.
dl.grip: Grip the bar overhand or with a mixed grip, shoulder-width or slightly wider.
dl.hipsLow: At the start, shoulders roughly over the bar, arms straight.
dl.lift: Lift by straightening your hips and knees together; finish standing tall with your hips through.
dl.lower: Lower the bar the same way: hips back, knees bend, back straight.
dyn.control: Move smoothly and build up your range gradually.
erg.drive: The drive: legs first, then swing your body back, then pull with your arms.
erg.finish: At the finish, legs straight, body leaning back slightly, handle just below your ribs.
erg.handle: Pull and return the handle along one straight path, toward the flywheel and back.
erg.recovery: Recover in reverse order: arms, body, and only then bend your knees.
erg.setup: Strap your feet in; at the start, arms straight, torso leaning forward from the hips, shins about vertical.
fidr.mis.back: Lifting your back off the pad.
fidr.move: Raise the dumbbells in front of you, elbows slightly bent, to about shoulder height; lower them slowly.
fidr.setup: Sit on an incline bench with your back against the pad, dumbbells hanging at your sides.
fly.control: Return slowly — don’t let the weight yank your arms back.
fly.elbows: Elbows slightly bent and held at the same angle throughout.
fly.posture: Shoulders back, chest up, a slight forward lean.
fp.chest: Keep your torso stable and upright.
fp.elbowsBack: Lead with your elbows — drive them back.
fp.move: Pull the rope towards your face; return until your arms are straight.
fp.setup: Set a rope on the cable at shoulder height or higher; grip the ends and step back until the cable is taut.
fro.mis.arch: Arching your lower back as your arms go overhead.
fro.move: Raise the weight in an arc in front of you until it is overhead, elbows slightly bent; then lower it slowly to your thighs.
front.elbows: Elbows straight or slightly bent — held the same way throughout.
front.move: Raise your arms in front of you, then lower them slowly.
front.setup: Stand with the dumbbells in front of your thighs, elbows straight or slightly bent.
front2.setup: Stand tall holding the weight in both hands in front of you, arms hanging down, elbows straight or slightly bent.
fsq.elbows: Don’t let your elbows drop — the weight then pulls your torso forward.
fsq.rack: Let the bar sit across the fronts of your shoulders, elbows high, upper arms roughly parallel to the floor.
gb.heels: Press your feet, especially your heels, into the floor.
gb.move: Lift your hips by squeezing your glutes until your shoulders, hips and knees form a line; lower slowly.
gb.noArch: Don’t push your hips above the line of your body — no arching in your lower back.
gb.setup: Lie face up with knees bent and both soles on the floor, hip-width apart.
gcalf.knee: Keep your knee straight — bending it shifts the stretch lower down the calf.
gcalf.move: Keeping your knee straight, lower your heel below the step until you feel a stretch in your calf, then hold.
gcalf.set: Stand with the ball of your foot on the edge of a step, heel hanging off.
gcalf.support: Hold on to something steady, like a wall, for balance.
gm.depth: Go down only to a mild hamstring stretch — no lower than a horizontal torso.
gm.light: Start very light and add weight gradually.
gm.move: Keeping your back straight, hinge forward by moving your hips back; come up by driving your hips forward.
gm.setup: Bar across your upper back, feet hip-width apart, knees slightly bent.
gob.close: Keep the weight close and don’t let your chest drop forward.
gob.hold: Hold a dumbbell or kettlebell upright against your chest, elbows close to your body.
gob.move: Squat down with your chest up and the weight at your chest; stand up by pushing the floor away.
hab.hips: Hips and torso stay still — only the leg moves.
hab.mis.high: Leg too high — your hip starts to tilt.
hack.move: Lower yourself by bending your hips and knees, then stand up by straightening your legs.
halo.close: Keep the kettlebell close as it circles your head.
halo.dir: Do your reps in one direction, then the same number in the other.
halo.move: Circle the kettlebell around your head: past one shoulder, behind your head, past the other shoulder and back in front of your chest.
halo.setup: Stand tall and hold the kettlebell by the horns in front of your chest.
halo.torso: Keep your back straight and your torso still through the whole movement.
hang.ribs: Ribs down, torso still — curl your hips up.
hang.slow: Lower your legs slowly, with control.
hext.mis.arch: Arching your back as your leg goes up.
hext.range: Lift your leg only as high as you can without arching your back.
hinge.back: Keep your back straight (neutral) throughout — no rounding.
ht.dbSetup: Upper back on a bench, soles on the floor; hold the dumbbell across your hips with both hands.
ht.hold: Hold the weight with your hands so it doesn’t roll.
ht.mis.arch: Arching your lower back at the top instead of extending your hips.
ht.move: Drive your hips up to full extension; lower them under control.
ht.rigid: Move only at the hips — don’t arch your lower back at the top.
ht.setup: Rest your upper back on the edge of a bench and the bar across your hips (ideally on a pad); feet flat, knees bent.
ibp.dbMove: Press the dumbbells up over your shoulders until your arms are straight; lower them slowly to the sides of your upper chest.
ibp.dbSetup: Sit on an incline bench with the dumbbells on your thighs, lie back and bring them to your shoulders.
ibp.move: Lower the bar to your upper chest, then press it up until your arms are straight.
ibp.setup: Lie on an incline bench: back and glutes against it, feet on the floor.
inc1.mis.shrug: Shrugging your shoulder up toward your ear as you lift.
inc1.move: Raise your arm up and out to the side, then lower it slowly.
inc1.setup: Lie on your side on an incline bench, dumbbell in your top hand.
inv.pull: Pull your chest up to the bar, elbows staying near your torso; lower to straight arms.
inv.rigid: Keep your body rigid: don’t let your hips sag.
inv.setup: Grip a bar or handles above you with your body straight from head to heels.
ipush.height: The higher the support, the easier — lower it gradually.
ipush.move: Lower your chest to the edge, then push back up until your arms are straight.
ipush.setup: Place your hands on the edge of a bench or stable platform, slightly wider than your shoulders; feet back, body straight.
isr.mis.press: Bending your elbows, which turns the move into a press.
isr.move: Without bending your elbows, push the weight higher by lifting your shoulders off the bench; then slowly lower your shoulder blades back down.
isr.setupBb: Lie back on an incline bench, holding the barbell above you with straight arms.
isr.setupDb: Lie back on an incline bench, holding the dumbbells above your shoulders with straight arms.
jm.elbows: Keep your elbows high and angled out from your body the whole time — don't let them drop or flare out.
jump.drive: Swing your arms and drive through your hips, knees and ankles.
jump.land: Land softly, with your knees bent.
kb.hips: The power comes from your hips, not your shoulders — your arms just guide the kettlebell.
kb.move: Send your hips back as the kettlebell passes between your legs, then snap your hips forward — the kettlebell swings up in front of you.
kb.setup: Stand behind the kettlebell, feet shoulder-width or a little wider; hinge at the hips with a straight back and grip the handle with both hands.
kbb.dbArmLate: Your arm only kicks in after your hips and knees straighten — until then it just holds the dumbbell loosely.
kbb.dbSnatchMove: Push the floor away, extend hard through your hips and knees, then guide the dumbbell up and punch it overhead.
kbb.dbSnatchSetup: Place the dumbbell between your feet; set up like a deadlift — flat back, chest up — and grab it with one hand.
kbb.dblCleanMove: Swing both bells back between your legs, then as your hips finish, pull them in close and end in the rack at your chest.
kbb.dblStance: Stand wider than hip-width so both bells fit between your legs.
kbb.dip: Keep the dip short and your torso upright.
kbb.lockout: At the top, lock your elbow — arm straight overhead.
kbj.fullExt: Finish extending your legs and hips before you drop under the weight.
kbj.lockFirst: Lock out your arms in the second dip — only then stand up.
kbj.move: Dip and drive the bells up, drop straight into a second dip under them with locked arms, then stand up.
kbj.rack: Kettlebells racked at your shoulders, elbows tucked in.
kick.move: Straighten your elbow, sending your hand back until your arm is straight; return to a right angle.
kick.setup: Lean forward with a straight back and rest your free hand on a bench or your thigh; keep your upper arm against your torso, elbow bent at a right angle.
kick.upperArm: Keep your upper arm still against your torso — only your forearm moves.
lat.elbows: Elbows slightly bent and leading — level with or above your hands.
lat.move: Raise your arms out to the sides, then lower them slowly.
lat.setup: Stand with the dumbbells by your thighs, elbows slightly bent, torso braced.
lat1.move: Raise your arm out to the side to about shoulder height, then lower it slowly.
lat1.setup: Stand tall with a dumbbell in one hand by your thigh, elbow straight or slightly bent.
lcurl.move: Bend your knees to pull your heels in toward your buttocks; slowly straighten your legs again.
lcurl.still: Keep your thighs and hips still; the movement happens only at the knees.
lext.range: Straighten your legs until your knees are fully extended; lower back to a bend of about a right angle.
llc.control: Move smoothly both ways, without jerking.
llc.hips: Keep your hips pressed down — no arching your back.
llc.move: Bend your knees to bring the pad towards your glutes; lower it slowly.
llc.setup: Lie face down with your knees in line with the machine’s pivot and the pad on your lower calves, above your heels.
lp.heels: Push through your whole foot — heels stay on the platform.
lp.hips: Don’t go so deep that your pelvis lifts off the seat and your lower back rounds.
lp.move: Push the platform away by straightening your hips and knees; lower it slowly by bending your legs.
lp.noLock: Don’t lock your knees out at the top.
lp.setup: Keep your back and pelvis against the backrest; feet flat on the platform, knees bent to roughly a right angle.
lpd.fullStretch: At the top, straighten your arms fully.
lpd.pull: Pull the bar down in front of your face to your upper chest.
lpd.thighs: Sit down and set the pads so they hold your thighs firmly; grip the bar.
lpd.toChest: Pull to your upper chest — no further.
lpote.move: Bend your elbow to lower the handle behind your head, then straighten your arm overhead.
lpote.setup: Stand with your back to the cable machine and hold the handle overhead in one hand, elbow pointing up.
lunge.back: Step back and lower until your rear knee is just above the floor; return by pushing through your front leg.
lunge.dbSetup: Stand tall, feet hip-width apart, dumbbells hanging at your sides.
lunge.fwd: Step forward and lower until your rear knee is just above the floor; push off your front leg back to the start.
lunge.knee: Front knee in line with your toes.
lunge.stand: Stand upright, feet roughly hip-width apart.
lunge.walk: Step forward and lower until your rear knee is just above the floor; rise onto your front leg and step straight into the next lunge.
mb.legs: Throw with your whole body — extend your hips, knees and ankles as you release.
mbcp.move: Push the ball hard from your chest straight ahead.
mbcp.setup: Face your target, ball in both hands at your chest.
mc.move: Switch legs at the same time: straighten the bent leg back and bring the straight one under your chest.
mc.setup: Hold yourself up on straight arms with your hands below your shoulders or a little ahead of them; one leg bent under your chest, the other straight behind you.
mc.stable: Keep your torso stable and your hips at about the same height.
mc.straight: Fully straighten the back leg on every switch.
mcp.blades: Keep your shoulder blades on the pad — don’t round your shoulders forward at the end.
mcp.move: Press the handles forward until your arms are straight; return slowly.
mcp.seat: Set the seat so the handles are level with the middle of your chest; back against the pad, feet on the floor.
mis.barAway: Letting the bar drift away from your body.
mis.elbowAway1: Letting your elbow drift away from your body as you push.
mis.elbowsAway: Letting your elbows drift away from your body as you push.
mis.jerk: Jerking or swinging the weight instead of moving under control.
mis.roundBack: Rounding your back to finish the lift.
msp.seat: Sit so the handles are at about shoulder height (adjust the seat).
nordic.catch: When you can no longer resist, catch yourself with your hands as in a push-up.
nordic.hips: Keep your hips extended: torso and thighs in one line, no bending at the hips.
nordic.move: Lean forward as slowly as you can, resisting with the back of your thighs.
nordic.setup: Kneel on a soft surface; your ankles must be held down firmly (a partner, rollers or an anchor).
npu.hang: Grip the handles fully (thumbs wrapped around) and hang with straight arms.
ohp.bbSetup: Take the bar from a rack at shoulder height; grip shoulder-width or a little wider, bar sitting across the fronts of your shoulders.
ohp.dbSetup: Dumbbells at your shoulders, elbows under your wrists.
ohp.elbowsUnder: Keep your elbows under your wrists throughout.
ohp.feet: Feet planted firmly on the floor.
ohp.fullExt: At the top, straighten your arms without slamming your elbows into lockout.
ohp.mis.lock: Snapping your elbows into lockout at the top.
ohp.move: Press the weight overhead until your arms are straight; lower it back to your shoulders.
ohp.seat: Sit with your back pressed into the backrest, feet planted on the floor; dumbbells at shoulder level.
ohp.tall: Stay tall and stable; the weight travels straight up overhead.
oly.back: Back flat and chest up at the start.
oly.close: Keep the bar close to your body the whole way up.
oly.legs: Keep your arms straight as long as you can — your legs and hips drive the bar.
oly.mis: Letting the bar drift away from your body, or rounding your back.
olympic.balanceMove: Dip, drive up and, as you push the bar overhead, step the front foot out into your full split.
olympic.balanceSetup: Bar resting on the front of your shoulders, feet in a short split — front foot closer in than in your full split.
olympic.blockSetup: Bar on blocks, usually at knee height.
olympic.catchHigh: Catch the bar in a partial squat.
olympic.catchLow: Catch the bar in a full squat and stand right up.
olympic.dip: Keep the dip short and straight — bend the knees, torso stays upright.
olympic.dipBrace: Brace your core hard before you bend your knees.
olympic.dipSquat: Dip like you would for a jerk, but slow and controlled, then stand back up smoothly — don't drive the bar up.
olympic.extend: Once the bar passes your knees, drive your hips and legs to full extension.
olympic.feet: Feet hip- to shoulder-width apart, toes turned slightly out.
olympic.feetHands: Your feet land at the same moment your arms lock out overhead.
olympic.hangExtend: From the hang, drive your hips and legs to full extension.
olympic.hangSetup: Stand up with the bar, then lower it to the hang by pushing your hips back — back flat, shoulders over the bar.
olympic.hangStart: Stand up with the bar, then lower it to just above your knees: hips back, back flat, shoulders over or slightly ahead of the bar.
olympic.jerkSetup: Bar resting on the front of your shoulders, feet in your jumping stance — about hip-width.
olympic.legsFirst: Start by pushing the floor away with your legs — arms stay straight.
olympic.mis.arms: Pulling with your arms before your legs and hips finish the extension.
olympic.mis.away: The bar drifts away from you — in the pull or off your hips.
olympic.mis.dipRushed: Rushing the dip and getting pulled out of position.
olympic.mis.forward: Driving the bar forward instead of straight up.
olympic.mis.leanBack: Leaning way back at the top.
olympic.mis.slowDrop: Dropping under the bar too slowly.
olympic.mis.softLockout: Soft elbows overhead — the bar pushes you down.
olympic.mis.standEarly: Standing up before the bar is stable overhead.
olympic.msMove: Extend hard, then pull your elbows up and out and turn the bar over and press it out overhead — no rebend of the knees.
olympic.overBar: Keep your shoulders over the bar as long as you can — don't lean back too early.
olympic.powerMove: Dip, drive the bar up with your legs and punch under it, feet moving a bit wider; catch it on straight arms in a partial squat, no lower than thighs parallel.
olympic.pullMove: Drive the bar up with your legs, extend hard at the hips and finish with a strong shrug — don't drop under the bar.
olympic.recover: Stand up with the bar still overhead, and only then lower it.
olympic.sbMove: Dip a little, drive the bar off your back and drop under it, moving your feet into your squat stance; catch it on straight arms at the bottom and stand up.
olympic.sbPush: As you drop under, punch your arms up into the bar.
olympic.sbSetup: Bar on your upper back, behind your neck, with a snatch grip.
olympic.setup: Wide grip, back flat and tight, shoulders over the bar.
olympic.setupBack: Start with a flat back and your core braced hard.
olympic.snatchMove: Drive the floor away with your legs, extend hard at the hips and pull yourself under — catch the bar on straight arms in a full squat, then stand up.
olympic.snatchPowerMove: Drive with your legs, extend hard at the hips and get under the bar — catch it on straight arms above a parallel squat, hips above knees.
olympic.snatchSplitMove: Pull like a snatch, then drop under the bar fast into a split — one foot forward, the other back — and stand up with the bar overhead.
olympic.splitCatch: Pull like a regular clean, but catch the bar in a split — one foot forward, one back.
olympic.splitMove: Dip, drive hard with your legs and, as you push the bar overhead, jump your feet into a split; catch it on straight arms.
olympic.squatMove: Dip at the knees, drive hard with your legs and, as you push the bar overhead, drop under it into a full squat; catch it on straight arms and stand up.
olympic.triple: Finish tall: hips, knees and ankles fully extended.
olympic.under: After the extension, whip your elbows around the bar and catch it on the front of your shoulders.
ote.elbowsIn: Don’t let your elbows flare wide.
ote.move: Bend your elbows to lower the dumbbell behind your head; straighten your arms overhead.
ote.moveLoad: Bend your elbows to lower the weight behind your head, then straighten your arms overhead.
ote.setup: Hold one dumbbell with both hands and press it overhead on straight arms.
ote.setupLoad: Hold the weight overhead with straight arms, elbows pointing up.
ote.upperArm: Keep your upper arms still with your elbows overhead — your forearms do the work.
ote1.move: Bend your elbow to lower the dumbbell behind your head, then straighten your arm overhead.
ote1.setup: Hold a dumbbell overhead in one hand, elbow pointing up.
ote1.upperArm: Keep your upper arm still with the elbow high above your head — your forearm does the work.
pallof.move: Push the handle forward from your chest until your arms are straight, pause briefly, then slowly bring it back to your chest.
pallof.noTwist: Do not let the cable turn your torso; keep your torso and hips still.
pallof.setup: Stand side-on to a cable at roughly chest level; grip the handle in both hands against your chest, with tension on the cable.
pendlay.floor: Begin each rep with the bar resting motionless on the floor.
pendlay.mis.torso: Lifting your torso as you pull.
pendlay.pull: Pull the bar explosively to your lower chest or upper stomach, then set it back down on the floor.
pendlay.setup: Start with the bar on the floor. Hinge until your torso is almost parallel to the floor, knees slightly bent, back flat.
pistol.assist: At first, hold a support or shorten the range of motion.
pistol.knee: Standing knee in line with your toes.
pistol.move: Squat down on the standing leg as low as you can control; stand back up to full extension.
pistol.setup: Stand on one leg with the other straight out in front above the floor; arms forward for balance.
plank.brace: Brace your abs to keep your torso rigid.
plank.mis.sag: Sagging hips and an arched lower back.
plank.move: Lift your body so head, hips and heels stay in one line; hold it and keep breathing normally.
plank.noSag: Don’t let your hips sag or pike up.
plank.setup: Rest on your forearms with your elbows right under your shoulders, legs straight.
plyo.altPushoff.move: Drive up off the foot on the box, switch legs in the air and land with the other foot on the box.
plyo.broadDrive: Swing your arms forward and drive hard with your legs, forward and up — as far as you can.
plyo.broadLand: In the air, reach your feet forward and land on both, bending your knees and hips.
plyo.broadLoad: Bend your knees and push your hips back, swinging your arms back.
plyo.dip: Bend your knees and push your hips back into a squat.
plyo.extend: Jump explosively, straightening your hips, knees and ankles together.
plyo.pushoff.setup: Face the box with one foot on top and the other on the floor.
plyo.tuck: In the air, pull your knees up to your chest.
plyo.wjsBarBack: Bar on your upper back, like a back squat.
plyo.wjsMove: Squat down and jump up as hard as you can.
po.arms: Arms straight through the whole movement.
po.slow: Lower the weight behind your head slowly, and bring it back over your chest just as slowly.
pp.dip: Keep the dip short, with your torso tight.
pp.legs: The drive comes from your legs and hips — your arms finish the press.
pp.move: Dip briefly at the knees, then drive your legs and hips straight explosively, pressing the bar overhead until your arms are straight.
pp.setup: Bar sitting across the fronts of your shoulders, grip about shoulder-width or a little wider, feet hip-width apart.
preacher.range: Use the full range: from a straight arm to a fully bent elbow.
preacher.setup: Rest the back of your upper arm on the preacher pad, armpit close to its edge.
press.noLock: Straighten your arms fully, but without snapping your elbows into lockout.
press1.noLock: Straighten your arm fully, but don't snap the elbow into lockout.
pu.elbowsDown: Drive your elbows down towards your sides.
pu.grip: Grip the bar overhand, slightly wider than your shoulders, and hang with straight arms.
pu.noSwing: No swinging or kicking your legs.
pu.partial: Cutting the range short — not straightening your arms at the bottom.
pu.pull: Pull up until your chin is over the bar; lower until your arms are fully straight.
pu.shoulders: Start the pull by drawing your shoulder blades down.
push.mis.partial: Cutting the range short — not going low enough or not straightening at the top.
push.move: Bend your elbows to bring your chest close to the floor; press back up to straight arms.
push.rigid: Keep your body rigid — hips neither sag nor pike up.
push.setup: Hands on the floor shoulder-width apart or slightly wider, body straight from head to heels.
rcrunch.hips: The pelvis leads the movement; do not swing your legs.
rcrunch.move: Curl your hips up off the floor toward your ribs, then slowly lower them back down.
rdelt.mis.swing: Swinging your torso to get the weight up.
rdl.dbMove: Push your hips back and lower the weight close to your legs with your knees slightly bent; come back up by driving your hips forward.
rdl.dbSetup: Stand tall with the dumbbells in front of or beside your thighs, feet hip-width apart.
rdl.depth: Go down as long as you feel the stretch in your hamstrings and can keep your back straight.
rdl.knees: Knees only slightly bent — this isn’t a squat.
rdl.mis.knees: Bending your knees too much, so the lift turns into a squat.
rdl.move: Push your hips back and slide the bar down close to your legs with your knees slightly bent; come back up by driving your hips forward.
rdl.setup: Stand tall with the bar against your thighs, feet hip- to shoulder-width apart, grip shoulder-width or a little wider.
rear.arms: Your arms travel out to the side, not back — your hands finish roughly in line with your shoulders.
rear.elbows: Keep the bend in your elbows fixed throughout.
rear.move: Raise your arms out to the sides to shoulder height, perpendicular to your torso; lower slowly.
rear.setup: Bend forward until your torso is nearly horizontal with a straight back (or rest your chest on an incline bench); dumbbells hanging, elbows slightly bent.
rear1.mis.high: Lifting your arm higher than your shoulder.
rear1.move: Raise your arm out to the side to shoulder height, at a right angle to your torso; lower it slowly.
rear1.setup: Lie face down on a bench; the arm holding the dumbbell hangs straight down.
rgpd.move: Straighten your elbows and push the bar down; return slowly.
rgpd.setup: Take the bar with an underhand grip, palms up, elbows at your sides.
ro.back: Hips extended, back flat — don’t let your lower back sag.
rot.elbow: Elbow bent and tucked at your side — only your forearm rotates.
rot.mis.elbowAway: Letting your elbow drift away from your body.
row.bbGrip: Grip the bar overhand, shoulder-width or wider.
row.bbPull: Pull the bar to your stomach, then lower it until your arms are straight.
row.dbPull: Pull the dumbbells to your stomach, then lower them until your arms are straight.
row.elbowsPast: Pull until your elbows pass the line of your back.
row.fullStretch: At the bottom, straighten your arms fully and let your shoulders reach down.
row.hinge: Hinge forward at the hips with your knees slightly bent; back straight.
row1.bench: Rest one knee and the same-side hand on a bench; torso roughly parallel to the floor, back straight.
row1.noTwist: Don’t twist your torso to heave the dumbbell up.
row1.pull: Pull the dumbbell up along your side, elbow back; lower until your arm is straight.
row1.top: Pull until your upper arm passes the line of your torso.
rpd.elbowsHigh: Keep your elbows high, at shoulder height.
rpd.move: Pull your arms out and back until your elbows are just behind your back; return slowly.
rpd.setup: Sit facing the pad with your chest against it; handles at shoulder height.
rt.back: Keep your back straight — don’t round it as you turn.
rt.control: Turn smoothly, without swinging the weight.
rt.move: Rotate your torso from side to side, leading with your shoulders.
rt.setup: Sit and lean back slightly with a straight back, knees bent; hold the weight in front of your chest.
run.bounce: Run smoothly, without unnecessary bouncing upward.
run.stride: Do not force a longer stride; slightly shorter is better than too long.
run.under: Land with your foot close under your body, not far in front of you; this reduces braking.
sapd.arms: Keep your arms straight throughout; do not bend your elbows.
sapd.move: With straight arms, pull the bar down toward your thighs; return slowly to the top.
sapd.setup: Set the cable high and hold the bar in front of you with straight arms.
sb.plane: Bend only to the side — no twisting, no leaning forward.
scap.move: Raise your arms forward and slightly out to the sides, up to shoulder height, then lower them.
scap.setup: Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand, arms straight.
scr.chest: At the end of the pull, chest forward and shoulder blades squeezed back.
scr.control: Return slowly, without letting the weight bounce at the end.
scr.pull: Row the handle to your stomach, elbows staying near your torso; return to straight arms.
scr.sit: Sit with your feet braced, knees slightly bent and back straight.
shrug.high: Raise your shoulders as high as you can.
shrug.move: Raise your shoulders, then lower them slowly.
shrug.setup: Stand tall holding the weight with straight arms.
shrug.tall: Keep your torso tall and still — only your shoulders move.
skull.depth: Lower until the bar is just above your forehead — or stop sooner if your upper arms start drifting back.
skull.depthFree: Lower until your hands are just above your forehead — or stop sooner if your upper arms start drifting back.
skull.move: Bend your elbows to lower the bar towards your forehead; straighten your arms back to the start.
skull.setup: Lie on a bench, grip the bar narrow and overhand, and hold it above your forehead on straight arms.
skull.upperArm: Keep your upper arms almost still and roughly vertical — the elbows do the work.
skullDb.move: Bend your elbows to lower the dumbbells toward your head, then straighten your arms back to the start.
skullDb.setup: Lie on a bench and hold the dumbbells above you with straight arms.
slam.move: Raise the ball overhead with both hands, then throw it down hard, straight into the floor.
sled.legs: Drive with your legs — push hard off the ground with every step.
sled.pushGrip: Stand behind the sled and grab the posts.
smr.tender: When you hit a tender spot, slow down and hold there for a moment.
soht.move: Bring the ball overhead and slightly behind your head, then throw it hard forward.
soht.setup: Face your target, ball in both hands.
splank.mis.elbow: Elbow too far in front of or behind your shoulder.
splank.move: Raise your hips until your head, hips and feet are in line; hold, then switch sides.
splank.noSag: Don’t let your hips sag or rotate forwards or backwards.
splank.setup: On your side, prop yourself on your forearm with the elbow directly below the shoulder; feet stacked.
sq.bar: Bar across your upper back, hands wider than your shoulders; lift it off the rack and step back a step or two.
sq.depth: Go as low as your mobility allows with a straight back and whole feet on the floor — usually at least to thighs parallel.
sq.down: Descend by moving your hips back while your knees bend at the same time; rise by pushing the floor away with your whole feet.
sq.kneesPast: Your knees may travel slightly past your toes — no need to force them back.
sq.kneesToes: Your knees track in line with your toes — they don’t cave in.
sq.stance: Feet about shoulder-width apart or a little wider, toes turned slightly out.
srf.move: Pull the handles out to the sides without changing your elbow angle; return under control.
srf.setup: Face the sled holding the handles in outstretched arms and step back until the rope is tight.
sri.move: With nearly straight arms, raise the barbell in front of you, then lower it slowly.
sri.setup: Lie chest-down on an incline bench; hold the barbell in an overhand grip with straight, hanging arms.
st.breathe: Breathe calmly — don’t hold your breath.
st.mis.force: Forcing your way into the stretch.
st.tension: Ease into the stretch slowly until you feel tension.
stepup.knee: Keep the knee of your stepping leg in line with your toes.
stepup.move: Place your whole foot on the box and step up by straightening that leg; step down under control the same way.
stepup.setup: Stand facing a stable box or bench with the dumbbells at your sides.
sumo.grip: Grip the bar between your legs, about shoulder-width apart.
sumo.kneesOut: When the bar breaks from the floor, push your knees outward so they point the same way as your toes.
sumo.lift: Lift by straightening your hips and knees; finish standing tall, chest up.
sumo.stance: Take a wide stance — feet outside your hands, toes and knees pointing the same way, outwards.
tate.move: With your elbows pointing out to the sides, bend them to lower the dumbbells to your chest, then straighten your arms.
tate.setup: Lie on a bench and hold the dumbbells above your chest with straight arms.
tb.inside: Stand inside the frame of the bar and grip the handles at your sides.
tb.lift: Lift by straightening your hips and knees together until you stand tall.
tbar.pull: Pull the handles to your torso, then lower until your arms are straight.
tgu.arm: Keep the kettlebell over your shoulder the whole time, arm straight.
tgu.eyes: Keep your eyes on the kettlebell the whole time.
thruster.dbSetup: Dumbbells at your shoulders, feet hip- to shoulder-width apart.
thruster.depth: Go down to at least thighs parallel.
thruster.fullExt: At the top, hips, knees and arms are fully straight.
thruster.kbSetup: Kettlebells racked at your shoulders, feet hip- to shoulder-width apart.
thruster.move: Squat down with the weight at your shoulders and, as you stand, push it overhead in one move; then bring it back down to your shoulders.
tpd.elbows: Elbows at your sides — your forearms move, not your shoulders.
tpd.move: Straighten your elbows to push the handle down; return until your forearms come close to your upper arms.
tpd.setup: Face the high pulley, grab the handle and pin your elbows to your sides.
tpd1.elbow: Keep your elbow at your side — your forearm moves, not your shoulder.
tpd1.move: Straighten your elbow and push the handle down; return slowly.
tpd1.setup: Face a high pulley and take the handle in one hand, elbow at your side.
tri.bandOte.move: Straighten your elbows to push your hands overhead; bend them to bring your hands back behind your head.
tri.bandOte.setup: Stand on the middle of the band, take its ends and bring your hands up behind your head, elbows pointing up.
tri.chainExt.move: Straighten your elbows while keeping your upper arms still; then lower the handles back.
tri.chainExt.setup: Lie on a flat bench with a chain handle in each hand, elbows pointing up.
tri.kick2.move: Straighten your elbows, sending your hands back until your arms are straight; return to a right angle.
tri.kick2.setup: With a dumbbell in each hand, lean forward with a straight back; keep your upper arms against your torso, elbows bent at a right angle.
tri.kickCb.setup: Face the cable machine, take the handle in one hand and step back; lean forward with a straight back, upper arm against your torso.
tri.mis.elbowDrift1: Letting your elbow drift forward instead of staying high.
tri.mis.elbowFlare1: Letting your elbow flare out to the side.
tri.mis.elbowsFlare: Letting your elbows flare out to the sides.
tri.mis.kickArm: Letting your upper arm move — drifting away from your torso or changing height.
tri.skullBand.move: Bend your elbows to lower your hands toward your head, then straighten your arms back to the start.
tri.skullBand.setup: Lie on a bench and hold the band above you with straight arms.
tri.skullBb.move: Bend your elbows to lower the barbell toward your head, then straighten your arms back to the start.
tri.skullBb.setup: Lie on a bench and hold the barbell above you with straight arms.
tri.skullBehind.move: Bend your elbows to lower the barbell to just past the top of your head, then straighten your arms back to the start.
tri.skullCb.move: Bend your elbows to lower the bar toward your head, then straighten your arms back to the start.
tri.skullCb.setup: Lie on a bench and hold the cable bar above you with straight arms.
tri.skullDb1.move: Bend your elbow to lower the dumbbell toward your head, then straighten your arm back to the start.
tri.skullDb1.setup: Lie on a bench and hold a dumbbell above you with a straight arm.
tri.skullDbDec.setup: Lie on a decline bench with your head lower than your hips and hold the dumbbells above you with straight arms.
tri.skullDec.setup: Lie on a decline bench with your head lower than your hips and hold the barbell above you with straight arms.
tri.skullInc.setup: Lie on an incline bench and hold the barbell above you with straight arms.
ur.elbows: Elbows lead the movement and stay higher than your hands.
urow.height: Bring the weight up close to your body to about shoulder height, elbows leading.
urow.move: Pull the weight up close to your body toward your collarbones, then lower it slowly until your arms are straight.
urow.setup: Stand tall, holding the weight in front of your thighs with straight arms, palms facing your body.
urow1.move: Pull the weight up close to your body toward your collarbone, then lower it slowly until your arm is straight.
urow1.setup: Stand tall, holding the weight in one hand in front of your thigh, arm straight, palm facing your body.
vup.back: Don’t arch or round your lower back.
walk.rails: Use the handrails at most for balance; do not lean hard on them or lean back, because that reduces the effort.
walk.upright: Walk tall with a steady torso.
wall.back: Keep your back against the wall and your torso upright.
wall.breath: Breathe normally; do not hold your breath.
wall.depth: The lower you go (the smaller the knee angle), the harder it gets; you can start higher and lower your position gradually.
wall.setup: Lean your back against a sturdy wall, walk your feet forward and slide down the wall to the chosen height.
wb.move: Squat down, then as you stand, throw the ball up to the target on the wall in one motion.
wb.setup: Face the wall and hold the ball with both hands at your chest.
wm.arm: Keep your top arm straight, with the weight over your shoulder.
wr.forearms: Forearms supported — only your wrist moves.
wr.range: Lower the weight as far as your wrist allows, then curl it up.
foam_roll.calf.path: Roll from the ankle up to just below the knee.
foam_roll.calf.setup: Sit with the roller under your calves, hands behind you, and lift your hips.
foam_roll.foot.path: Roll the sole back and forth, from the heel to the ball of your foot.
foam_roll.foot.setup: Sit and put your foot on a ball or roller.
foam_roll.ham.path: Roll from just above the knee up to your glutes.
foam_roll.ham.setup: Sit with the roller under the backs of your thighs and prop yourself up on your hands.
foam_roll.it.hipBone: Don’t press the roller into the bone at the side of your hip.
foam_roll.it.path: Roll the side of your thigh between hip and knee.
foam_roll.it.setup: Lie on your side with the roller under the outside of your thigh.
foam_roll.it.topLeg: Cross your top leg in front and put that foot on the floor.
foam_roll.lat.path: Roll along the side of your torso, starting just below the armpit.
foam_roll.lat.setup: Lie on your side with the roller just below your armpit.
foam_roll.offKnee: Keep the roller above the knee, not on the joint.
foam_roll.oneLeg: For more pressure, roll one leg and rest the other on top.
foam_roll.pir.path: Roll your glute in short strokes, supporting yourself on your hands.
foam_roll.pir.setup: Sit on the roller and rest one ankle on the opposite knee.
foam_roll.quad.path: Roll from just above the knee up to the hip.
foam_roll.quad.setup: Lie face down, propped on your forearms, roller under your thighs.
foam_roll.ub.path: Push through your feet to roll up and down your upper back.
foam_roll.ub.setup: Lie on your back with the roller across your upper back, feet on the floor.
mobility_floor.n.bfHinge: Hinge forward from your hips and gently press your thighs down with your elbows.
mobility_floor.n.f4Cross: Lie on your back, knees bent, and rest one ankle on the opposite knee.
mobility_floor.n.f4Pull: Pull the other leg toward your chest until you feel a stretch in your glute.
mobility_floor.n.hingeFlat: Hinge from your hips and keep your back straight.
mobility_floor.n.mis.roundBack: Rounding your back and tucking your pelvis under.
mobility_floor.n.qPull: Pull your heel toward your glutes, knees together.
mobility_floor.n.qSide: Lie on your side and grab the foot of your top leg.
mobility_floor.t.catCow.arch: Then let your belly sink toward the floor so your back arches.
mobility_floor.t.catCow.exhale: Breathe out as you round your back.
mobility_floor.t.catCow.round: Round your back up toward the ceiling and let your head drop.
mobility_floor.t.catCow.setup: Get on all fours, hands under your shoulders and knees under your hips.
mobility_floor.t.catCow.smooth: Move slowly and smoothly between the two positions.
mobility_floor.t.child.reach: Keep your arms stretched out in front and lower your chest toward the floor.
mobility_floor.t.child.setup: Kneel and put your hands on the floor in front of you.
mobility_floor.t.child.sitBack: Sit your hips back toward your heels.
mobility_floor.t.supTwist.mis.shoulder: Lifting a shoulder off the floor.
mobility_floor.t.supTwist.move: Slowly lower both knees to one side; your shoulders stay on the floor.
mobility_floor.t.supTwist.setup: Lie on your back with your knees bent and your feet flat on the floor.
mobility_floor.t.supTwist.shoulders: Keep both shoulders on the floor.
mobility_floor.u.ankleStrap: Sit and loop a strap or towel around your foot.
mobility_floor.u.evert: Pull on the outer end of the strap to turn your foot outward.
mobility_floor.u.invert: Pull on the inner end of the strap to turn your foot inward.
mobility_floor.u.mis.roundInstead: Rounding your back instead of hinging from your hips.
mobility_floor.u.straddleSit: Sit with your legs wide apart, kneecaps and toes pointing up.
mobility_stand.d.ankleCircles: Circle your foot at the ankle one way, then the other.
mobility_stand.d.armCircles: Circle your arms forward, then backward.
mobility_stand.d.armsT: Hold your arms straight out to the sides at shoulder height.
mobility_stand.d.footUp: Lift one foot just off the floor.
mobility_stand.s.chinMove: Slowly lower your chin toward your chest.
mobility_stand.s.chinShouldersStill: Keep your shoulders still — only your head moves.
mobility_stand.s.claspMove: Squeeze your shoulder blades together and lift your chest a little — you’ll feel it across your chest and the front of your shoulders.
mobility_stand.s.claspSet: Stand tall and clasp your hands behind your back.
mobility_stand.s.mis.heelUp: Letting the back heel come off the floor.
mobility_stand.s.neckSet: Stand tall with your shoulders down.
mobility_stand.s.neckShouldersDown: Keep your shoulders down, away from your ears.
mobility_stand.s.neckSideMove: Slowly tilt your head, ear toward your shoulder, until you feel the side of your neck stretch.
mobility_stand.s.shoulderLoose: Keep the shoulder relaxed — don’t let it creep up to your ear.
mobility_stand.s.soleusMove: Bend your back knee slightly, keeping the heel down — you’ll feel it lower in the calf.
mobility_stand.s.triMove: Use your other hand to press lightly on the elbow until you feel the back of your upper arm stretch.
mobility_stand.s.triSet: Raise your arm, bend the elbow and drop your hand down toward the middle of your back.
mobility_stand.s.wallCalfMove: Bend the front knee and shift toward the wall; back leg straight, heel down.
mobility_stand.s.wallCalfSet: Hands on the wall, one leg back, both feet flat and toes pointing forward.
mobility_stand.s.xbodyMove: Hold the elbow with your other hand and gently pull the arm in.
mobility_stand.s.xbodySet: Raise your arm to shoulder height and bring it across your chest.
mobility_stand.u.wristCircles: Circle your hands at the wrists.
rotator_cuff.bandSetup: Anchor the band at waist height and stand side-on to it.
rotator_cuff.erMove: Swing your hand out, away from your stomach, as far as feels comfortable.
rotator_cuff.erStart: Hold the band in the hand farther from the anchor, elbow bent at a right angle at your side, forearm across your stomach.
rotator_cuff.irMove: Pull your hand in to your stomach.
rotator_cuff.irStart: Hold the band in the hand closer to the anchor, elbow bent at a right angle at your side.
rotator_cuff.sideMove: Raise the dumbbell by turning your forearm up, elbow pinned to your side.
rotator_cuff.sideSetup: Lie on your side, top elbow bent at a right angle against your side, dumbbell in front of your stomach.
yr.mis.chest: Lifting your chest off the bench.
arnold.setup: Dumbbells in front of your face, palms facing you.
arnold.move: Press the dumbbells overhead while turning your palms so they face forward at the top; turn them back toward you on the way down.
arnold.together: Turn and press at the same time — don’t turn first and then press.
ohp.mis.arch: Arching your lower back as you press.
ohp.bbGrip: Grip a little wider than your shoulders; bar in front of your shoulders.
ohp.mis.flare: Elbows flaring out to the sides instead of pointing forward.
kbp.setup: Kettlebell at your shoulder, elbow close to your ribs.
kbp.move: Press the kettlebell straight overhead; lower it back to your shoulder, pulling your elbow down to your ribs.
ohp.mis.sideLean: Leaning to the side to get the weight up.
band.ohpSetup: Stand on the band, grab both ends and raise your hands to about shoulder level, elbows bent.
band.ohpMove: Press your hands overhead, then slowly return to the start position.
ohp.saSetup: Stand steady with the dumbbell in one hand at your shoulder.
ohp.saMove: Press the dumbbell overhead until your arm is straight; lower it under control back to your shoulder.
rollout.wheel.setup: Kneel and grip the wheel with both hands in front of your knees, arms straight.
rollout.wheel.move: Slowly roll the wheel forward, lowering your torso toward the floor, then roll back to kneeling.
renegade.setup: Plank on dumbbells set under your shoulders, legs straight, feet shoulder-width or wider.
renegade.move: Row one dumbbell to the side of your torso, set it down with control and switch hands.
renegade.mis.twist: Twisting the hips and torso to heave the dumbbell up.
rollout.bar.setup: Kneel in front of the bar and grip it with both hands.
rollout.bar.move: Roll the bar forward, lowering your torso toward the floor, then pull it back in.
rollout.range: Roll out only as far as you can without arching your lower back.
rollout.mis.arch: Arching your lower back as you roll out.
fly.mis.elbows: Bending and straightening your elbows during the rep.
dip.setup: Grab the bars and push up onto straight arms, feet off the floor.
dip.move: Bend your elbows to lower yourself between the bars, then push back up to straight arms.
dip.mis.depth: Dropping too low or stopping too high.
dip.mis.overLean: Leaning too far forward and letting your chest sink between the bars.
cpress.seated: Sit with your back against the pad and feet on the floor; handles by your chest, elbows bent.
cpress.seatedMove: Press the handles straight out, then slowly bring them back toward your chest.
press.mis.lock: Snapping your elbows into lockout at the end of the press.
dpush.setup: Hands on the floor, feet on a bench or step; body straight from head to heels.
push.mis.sag: Letting your hips sag so your body is no longer in a straight line.
spush.setup: Hold the strap handles with straight arms in front of you; lean forward with your body straight and at an angle.
spush.move: Lower your chest toward your hands by bending your elbows; push back up until your arms are straight.
push.mis.flare: Elbows flaring wide to the sides.
calf.stepOne: Stand on the edge of a step on the ball of one foot, heel hanging off; lift the other foot.
calf.seatedEdge: Sit with your knees bent, the balls of your feet on a raised edge and your heels hanging off.
calf.stand: Stand tall with your toes pointing forward.
calf.rise: Rise up onto your toes, then lower your heels under control.
calf.band: Stand tall, holding the band ends or handles.
ck.setup: Set the pulley low, strap the cuff around your ankle and face the machine, holding on to it.
ck.move: Push your leg back by squeezing your glute, then slowly return.
ck.mis.sway: Swinging your hips and torso to get your leg further back.
fh.move: Keeping your knee bent, lift your leg out to the side, then bring it back down.
fh.level: Move only at the hip — don’t lean or twist your hips to get the leg higher.
fh.mis.twist: Your hips twist or tip to get the leg higher.
dk.move: Keeping your knee bent, lift your leg back and up, sole toward the ceiling, then lower it slowly.
clam.setup: Lie on your side, knees bent, legs stacked.
clam.move: Keeping your feet together, lift your top knee as high as you can without rolling your hips back, then lower it slowly.
clam.noRoll: Don’t let your hips roll back — stay on your side.
clam.mis.roll: Your hips roll back to get the knee higher.
hexb.setup: Loop a mini band around both ankles and shift your weight onto one leg.
bw.setup: Loop a mini band just above your knees or around your ankles; feet hip-width apart.
bw.move: Step to the side, then slowly follow with the other foot.
bw.tension: Keep the band tight the whole time — don’t let it go slack.
bw.mis.sway: Swaying your upper body side to side with each step.
gb.slSetup: Lie on your back, one knee bent with that foot flat on the floor; straighten the other leg or pull that knee toward your chest.
gb.slMove: Press your foot into the floor, especially the heel, and lift your hips; lower them slowly.
ht.slSetup: Rest your upper back against a bench, one foot flat on the floor, the other foot off the floor.
gb.bbSetup: Lie on your back under the bar so it rests across your hips; knees bent, feet flat on the floor, hip-width apart.
bandcurl.setup: Sit facing the band’s anchor, loop the band around your ankle, leg straight out in front.
bandcurl.move: Bend your knee, pulling the band back with your heel; then slowly straighten your leg.
lcurl.full: Bend your knee as far as you can.
lcurl.mis.partial: Bending your knee only halfway instead of all the way.
hack.setup2: Lean back against the pad, shoulders under the shoulder pads; feet on the platform in your usual squat stance.
hack.mis.hips: Hips or lower back coming off the pad.
slp.setup: Sit in the machine with your back against the backrest; put one foot on the platform, take the other foot off and keep it still.
lp.mis.lock: Locking your knee out at the top.
calf.seatedEdge1: Sit with your knee bent, the ball of your foot on a raised surface and your heel hanging off the edge.
row.cbPull: Pull the handles to your stomach, then return until your arms are fully straight.
meadows.setup2: Stand side-on to the bar in a staggered stance, hinge at the hips and grab the end of the bar overhand; rest your other forearm on your front thigh.
meadows.pull: Drive your elbow back and pull the bar toward your hip; lower slowly until your arm is straight.
scrow.setup: Set the cable at about chest height, grab the handle with both hands and stand facing the stack, knees slightly bent.
scrow.pull: Pull the handle to your torso, then return slowly.
scrow.mis.lean: Leaning back or forward to pull the weight in.
mrow.setup: Adjust the seat height to the handles, sit tall and grab them.
mrow.pull: Pull the handles to your torso, elbows back; return to the start.
lpd.thighsOnly: Sit down and set the pads so they hold your thighs firmly.
lpd1.setup: Hold the handle in one hand, arm straight overhead.
lpd1.pull: Pull the handle down to your shoulder; return slowly until your arm is straight.
lpd1.blade: Start by drawing your shoulder blade down and back.
lpd.mis.lean: Swinging and leaning back to get the weight down.
lpd.mis.shrug: Shoulders creeping up toward your ears.
lpd.still: Keep your torso steady — no swinging.
lpd.vbarSetup: Sit down, set the pads so they hold your thighs firmly and grab the V-bar, palms facing each other.
lpd.vbarPull: Pull the handle to your upper chest, shoulder blades down and back; return slowly until your arms are straight.
shrug.mis.roll: Rolling your shoulders instead of moving straight up and down.
shrug.mis.elbows: Bending your elbows and pulling with your arms instead of your shoulders.
shrug.setupBehind: Stand tall with the bar behind your thighs, overhand grip, arms straight.
curl2.zottSetup: Hold the dumbbells at your sides, palms facing forward.
zottman.move: Curl the dumbbells up palms-up, turn your palms down at the top and lower them with an overhand grip.
preacher.arms: Keep your upper arm resting on the preacher pad the whole time.
rotator_cuff.cableSetup: Set a single handle on the cable at waist height and stand side-on to it.
rotator_cuff.erStartCable: Hold the handle in the hand farther from the machine, elbow bent at a right angle at your side, forearm across your stomach.
rotator_cuff.pullHold: Hold the band in both hands with your arms out in front at chest height.
rotator_cuff.pullMove: Pull the band apart, squeezing your shoulder blades together; keep your hands at chest height.
rotator_cuff.mis.shrug: Shrugging your shoulders up to your ears.
rotator_cuff.cubanStand: Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand.
rotator_cuff.cubanBlades: Before you start, set your shoulder blades down and back.
rotator_cuff.cubanRow: Lift your elbows out to shoulder height, bent at a right angle, dumbbells hanging down.
rotator_cuff.cubanRotate: Rotate your forearms up without dropping your elbows; upper arms stay level.
